title: Top 5 Halloween Parties in South Florida + What to Wear
igCaption:
Top 5 Halloween parties in South Florida + what to wear to each 🎃

5. Halloween Bar Crawl, Barsecco (Brickell), Sat 10/31, 4–10pm, 21+
4. Haunted W Miami Rooftop, 485 Brickell Ave, 9pm–2am
3. Wicked Manors, Wilton Drive, 6–11pm, "Masquerade of Mayhem"
2. Hocus Pocus at Factory Town, Oct 30–Nov 1, 18+, from $65
1. HalloWYN, Wynwood Marketplace, FREE, 7pm–3am

Tag who you're matching costumes with 👀

Sources: Eventbrite, Factory Town, Wicked Manors

#SouthFloridaHalloween #HalloweenParty #SouthFloridaEvents #HalloweenCostume

scenes.text: Top five Halloween parties in South Florida. And exactly what to wear to each one.

Number five. The Halloween Bar Crawl starts at Barsecco in Brickell. Saturday, October thirty-first, four to ten p.m. Twenty-one and up. Wear a group costume. Matching cops or the whole squad as devils.

prompts: Styled product flat lay of two matching women's sexy police officer Halloween costumes and two red devil costumes with horns, laid out on a dark bar counter with neon purple and orange light, no people

scenes.text: Number four. The Haunted W Miami rooftop party. Fifteen floors up on Brickell Avenue, nine p.m. to two a.m. Wear an all-black angel or devil look. It pops against the skyline.
scenes.caption: Number four. The Haunted W Miami rooftop party. 15 floors up on Brickell Avenue, 9 p.m. to 2 a.m. Wear an all-black angel or devil look. It pops against the skyline.

prompts: Fashion product photo of a black angel Halloween costume with black feathered wings and a black corset dress on a mannequin, on a rooftop at night with a glowing city skyline behind, no people

scenes.text: Number three. Wicked Manors. Wilton Drive shuts down for the biggest Halloween street party in the Southeast. Six to eleven p.m. This year's theme is Masquerade of Mayhem. Wear a masquerade mask and go all out. If you go, open NEAR and see who else is on the street with you.

prompts: Product photo of an ornate gold and black Venetian masquerade mask with feathers and a dramatic red masquerade gown on a mannequin, festive street lights bokeh behind, no people

scenes.text: Number two. Hocus Pocus at Factory Town. Three days, five stages, Eric Prydz headlining. October thirtieth to November first. Eighteen and up, single days from sixty-five dollars. Wear a bunny or cowgirl rave look. Skip the cop costume. They ban anything that looks like law enforcement.

scenes.text: And number one. HalloWYN in Wynwood. It's free. Saturday night, seven p.m. to three a.m. at Wynwood Marketplace. RSVP and your first drink is free. Wear the sexy cop costume. This is where it belongs.
